A small website gets a sudden wave of attention.
A small brand needs the right moment.

Start with the advertiser's facts and approved benefits.
PetFrame and the three publishers are fictional demo examples.

Replay labeled sample traffic through the real spike detector.
A traffic spike is a signal—not yet a recommendation.

Connect your own Codex or Claude Code through MCP.
The agent can recommend and draft. Approval and payment stay with you.

The connected AI explains the fit and cites publisher facts.
It can reject a popular site when the visitor's task does not match.

Open the AI-generated sponsorship in the web studio.
Preview it in the publisher's actual placement context.

Edit the headline and save your version.
The advertiser decides which creative is approved.

One placement: $10 USD for 30 minutes.
PayPal Sandbox only. No real money moves.

Complete an actual PayPal Sandbox checkout.
The server verifies the order, amount, currency and completed capture.

A verified capture activates the approved snapshot.
The creative and destination are now fixed.

The sponsorship appears below the normal save action.
The stored creative is served without another AI call.

Viewable impressions and clicks update in the report.
The placement stops at expiry. Creator payouts are outside this demo.
